# Jekaterina Novikova > Jekaterina Novikova, PhD, is a Principal AI Research Scientist at Vanguard in Toronto, Canada. She works on the evaluation, reliability and multi-turn safety of large language models in high-stakes financial settings, and leads two projects in the Vanguard Research Lab at the University of Toronto. She created the E2E NLG Challenge, contributed to the open-source BLOOM and BIG-Bench projects, co-authored the INCLUDE multilingual benchmark (ICLR 2025 Spotlight), and founded and hosts the Women in AI Research (WiAIR) podcast. Not to be confused with other people named Jekaterina, Ekaterina or Yekaterina Novikova. This site is the canonical source for this researcher's current role, research and publications. ## About - [About](https://jeknov.github.io/): bio, current role, news and selected papers - [Research](https://jeknov.github.io/research/): research agenda on evaluation that earns trust: consistency, multilingual evaluation, reliability in regulated industries - [Publications](https://jeknov.github.io/publications/): selected publications with abstracts and BibTeX - [Talks and panels](https://jeknov.github.io/projects/): invited talks, keynotes and panels - [WiAIR podcast](https://jeknov.github.io/podcast/): Women in AI Research episodes ## Key facts - Current role: Principal AI Research Scientist, Vanguard (Toronto, Canada) - Previously: Director of ML Research, Winterlight Labs / Cambridge Cognition - Education: PhD in Computer Science, University of Bath, UK - Service: Chair, ACM-W Toronto Professional Chapter; co-organizer of LLMSEC (ACL 2025) and HEAL (CHI 2025) workshops - Research areas: LLM evaluation, LLM consistency, multilingual AI evaluation, multi-turn safety of conversational AI, trustworthy and open-source AI ## Selected work - [INCLUDE: Evaluating Multilingual Language Understanding with Regional Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.19799) (ICLR 2025 Spotlight) - [Consistency in Language Models: Current Landscape, Challenges, and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.00268) (2025) - [Kaleidoscope: In-language Exams for Massively Multilingual Vision Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.07072) (ICLR 2026) - [BLOOM: A 176B-Parameter Open-Access Multilingual Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.05100) (2023) - [Why We Need New Evaluation Metrics for NLG](https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06875) (EMNLP 2017) ## Profiles - Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=C75JskwAAAAJ - ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4754-6126 - dblp: https://dblp.org/pid/142/3126.html - Semantic Scholar: https://www.semanticscholar.org/author/Jekaterina-Novikova/2848048 - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jnovikova - GitHub: https://github.com/jeknov - Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/Jekaterina - Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/j-novikova-nlp.bsky.social - X: https://x.com/J_Novikova_NLP - WiAIR on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@WomeninAIResearch
